scope: independent model preparation; not native production-C or CN/QCP tool results
allocation_policy: Preparation chooses the lowest free root at the smallest available order. Production replay must co-simulate actual allocation choices; exact model addresses are not ground truth.
guards: get/put are guarded by actual handle liveness; put_all releases the actual client reference count for every allocated handle, including any whose result differs from preparation
specification_scope: Allocation success/exhaustion expectations are supplemental functional-model checks. The original hyp_alloc_pages postcondition permits NULL and does not state allocation completeness; a stronger shared CN/QCP contract is needed to classify completeness mutants as specification violations.
model_checks: conservation of all eight pages after each operation

illustrative_missing_min_model_mutant.scope: Python model mutation only; not an original C mutant verdict
